name: assay
description: Analyzes the instruction files an agent loads — CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules/, AGENTS.md, skills and hooks — flagging what is vague, stale, buried, or better served by a mechanism, and rewriting the weak ones. /assay:opus5, /assay:sonnet5, /assay:haiku45 and /assay:fable5 audit this host, one per model; /assay:codex audits the other; craft-rules and craft-skill write new ones.
